αἰακίδαο: Αἰακίδης — descendant of Aeacus, here Achilles (grandson of Aeacus); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
αἰπεινὰ: αἰπεινός — steep, sheer, lofty; neut. acc. pl.
αἰπύ: αἰπύς — high, steep, sheer; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τεῖχος
αἴθωνες: αἴθων — blazing, fiery, tawny; masc. nom. pl., of oxen: ’fire-bright, tawny’
αἶαν: Αἴας — Ajax, son of Telamon; masc. voc. sg. Αἶαν · also αἶα — earth, land; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic γῆ): ’all the earth’ (πᾶσαν ἐπ’ αἶαν)
βροτῷ: βροτός — mortal; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀνδρί: ’to/for a mortal man’
γένος: γένος — stock, race, lineage, offspring; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., governed by μετά: ’after (blood and) lineage’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of εὔχομαι: ’descent, birth’ (γένος εὔχομαι ’I declare my birth’) · also neut. acc. sg. of respect: ’by birth’ (ἐξ Ἰθάκης γένος εἰμί ’I am of Ithaca by birth’) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object of a verb: ’race, family’ (καταισχύνειν πατέρων γένος ’to shame the race of the fathers’)
γέροντες: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. nom. pl.
γλῶσσα: γλῶσσα — tongue, language; fem. nom. sg.
δέγμενος: δέχομαι — receive; wait for, await; syncopated aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg. with present sense, epic (= Attic δεξάμενος)
δαΐφρων: δαΐφρων — of uncertain sense, either ’wise-minded’ or ’warlike’; masc. nom. sg., epithet (of a craftsman) · also masc. nom. sg., epithet of a suitor, in apposition to a name
δινήεντος: δινήεις — eddying, whirling; masc. gen. sg., with ποταμοῦ
δῖ: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. voc. sg., elided (δῖ’ = δῖε) · also fem. nom. sg., elided (δῖ’ = δῖα): ’heavenly’, epithet of Aphrodite
εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν before a vowel) — in, on; + dat.
εἴσατο: εἴδομαι — appear, seem, look like; aor. 3 sg. · also + dat. of a person: ’come into view, appear (to someone)’ · also ἵεμαι — speed, rush; aor. 3 sg. mid., ’sped, went’ (διαπρὸ δὲ εἴσατο χαλκός ’the bronze sped clean through’)
θύρῃσι: θύρη — door; dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic θύραις; Ionic η for α)
κάλλιστον: καλός — beautiful, fine; superl. κάλλιστος, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’fairest, finest’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κεῖνον: ’the most beautiful (man)’ (κεῖνον … κάλλιστον ’that one the most beautiful’)
κικόνων: Κίκονες — the Cicones, a Thracian people; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the Cicones’
κλυτὰ: κλυτός — famous, renowned; neut. nom./acc. pl.
κούρη: κούρη — girl, daughter; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’daughter’ (θάρσει, Ἰκαρίου κούρη ’take heart, daughter of Icarius’)
λαὸς: λαός — people, host, community; masc. nom. sg.
λυγρὸν: λυγρός — baneful, bitter, grievous; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γῆρας: ’grievous (old age)’
μέλαν: μέλας — black, dark; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μέλανος: μέλας — black, dark; masc./neut. gen. sg.
μέμασαν: μέμονα — be eager, be minded, strive; perf. 3 pl. (pres. sense), epic μέμασαν: ’were set on’ + inf.
μεγάλοι: μέγας — great, large; masc. nom. pl.
μῦθοι: μῦθος — word, speech, talk; masc. nom. pl.
ναῦφιν: ναῦς — ship; pl. with epic suffix -φιν, ablatival (’from the ships’; = Attic νεῶν)
νείατον: νείατος — farthest, last, lowest; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic νέατος)
οἰωνοῖσιν: οἰωνός — bird of prey, bird of omen; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
οἷσί: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic οἷς), accented before the enclitic περ; dat. after πέποιθε ’trusts in’ · also accented before the enclitic τε, dat. of interest: ’whose’ (οἷσί τε τέκνα ’whose young’)
πάσης: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. gen. sg.
πίνοντες: πίνω — drink; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
παῖδας: παῖς — child, son; masc. acc. pl.
πεδίοιο: πεδίον — plain; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), governed by ἀνάσσεις · also gen. of the space traversed: κονίοντες πεδίοιο ’raising dust over the plain’
πεζοί: πεζός — on foot; masc. nom. pl.: ’foot-soldiers’
περίδρομος: περίδρομος — running round, open all round; fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.)
ποδώκεος: ποδώκης — swift-footed (πούς + ὠκύς); masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
πολὺς: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. sg., grave accent, mid-clause form (χειμὼν πολὺς ’much winter storm’)
προτὶ: πρός (epic by-form προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also adverb ’besides, in addition’, or preverb in tmesis: ’in, to (oneself)’ (προτὶ … ἐκάλεσσας = προσεκάλεσσας ’called in’)
πόλιος: πόλις — city; fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic πόλεως)
πύλαι: πύλη — gate; fem. nom. pl. (the plural is the usual form)
πᾶσα: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg.: ’all over’
πᾶσαι: πᾶς — all, every; fem. nom. pl.
σκοπὸς: σκοπός — watcher, look-out, guard; masc. nom. sg.
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — tool, gear, armor, equipment; neut. nom./acc. pl.
τύμβῳ: τύμβος — burial mound, tomb; masc. dat. sg.
τῆλ: τῆλε (elided/apocopated τῆλ’) — far, far away; adv.
φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’used to bear’ · also ’carried, were carrying’ (φέρον ἐσθῆτα ’they carried the clothes’) · also impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερον): ’I carried, I was carrying’
φθογγὴν: φθογγή — voice, sound; fem. acc. sg.
ψαμάθοισιν: ψάμαθος — sand; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀγγελίῃ: ἀγγελίη — message, news; fem. dat. sg.
ἀγορὰς: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. acc. pl. (Attic ἀγοράς)
ἀγόρευον: ἀγορεύω — speak, say, declare; impf. 3 pl.
ἀλεγεινῇ: ἀλεγεινός — painful, grievous; adj., fem. dat. sg.
ἀμφί: ἀμφί — around, about, on both sides of; prep. + acc. · also preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφί … ἕπον = ἀμφέπον ’busied themselves about, dressed’)
ἀφνειοὶ: ἀφνειός — rich, wealthy; masc. nom. pl.
ἀφροδίτη: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. nom. sg.
ἄγον: ἄγω — lead, bring, take along; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγον): ’I took along’ · also impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, with ἐκ in tmesis (ἐκ … ἄγον = ἐξῆγον): ’they led out, carried off’ · also impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they led, brought’ (ἄγον ζώσαντες)
ἄλλη: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. sg., adverbial in the idiom ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’one this way, another that’ · also plain adj., fem. nom. sg.: ’other’ (οὔ τις ... ἄλλη ’no other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. distributive: ’one … another’ (ἄλλη δ’ ἄλλων γλῶσσα ’each tongue differing from the others’)
ἐεισαμένη: εἴδομαι — liken oneself to (+ dat.); aor. mid. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐεισ- (= εἰσαμένη): ’having made herself like’
ἐπιτέλλομαι: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, charge, command (+ dat.); pres. 1 sg. mid.: ’I enjoin’
ἐρύσατο: ἐρύομαι — protect, rescue, save; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’saved, shielded’
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg. impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also existential, ‘there is’ (ἔστι δέ τις πέτρη ‘there is a rock’) · also with a dat. of possession: ’is, belongs to’ (τά μοι ἔστι ’which are mine’)
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἡγήσατο: ἡγέομαι — lead the way, go before; aor. 3 sg.
ἦγον: ἄγω — lead, bring, drive; impf. 3 pl.
ἱππῆές: ἱππεύς — horseman, charioteer; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic ἱππεῖς/ἱππῆς); accent from enclitic τε
ἴεν: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔει)
ὀρυμαγδὸς: ὀρυμαγδός — din, uproar, clamour; masc. nom. sg.
ὀρώρει: ὄρνυμι — rouse; (intrans.) arise, spring up; pluperf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’had sprung up’
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
ὄπωπα: ὁράω — see; perf. 1 sg., epic stem ὀπ- with present force (= Attic ἑώρακα): ’I have seen’
ὄρχαμος: ὄρχαμος — chief, leader; masc. nom. sg. (ὄρχαμος ἀνδρῶν ’chief of men’)
ὠκέα: ὠκύς — swift; neut. pl. (-έα) used adverbially: ’swiftly’ · also fem. nom. sg., epic -έα (= -εῖα): ’swift’
ῥοὰς: ῥοή — stream, flow; fem. acc. pl.
